provider.readme:
# Grok — xAI
xAI's flagship chat web UI at [grok.com](https://grok.com). The browser bridge drives the logged-in X/Premium session — your existing X Premium subscription is the rate limiter, no xAI API key required.
**Models typically exposed** (subject to discovery on first login):
- Grok 4 — flagship reasoning ("Think" mode) - Grok 4 Heavy — multi-agent reasoning (Premium+ tier) - Grok 4 Fast — low-latency default
**First-time setup:** sign in with your existing X account; Grok inherits that auth. Premium / Premium+ / SuperGrok subscriptions unlock the higher reasoning tiers.
